name: quote_tier_transaction_20261109
comment: ANCHOR: QUOTE_TIER_TRANSACTION_20261109 — LQ-20261107-1609. The Finviz middle tier of the quote
ingest held ONE transaction open across its whole per-symbol loop (up to ~156 HTTP requests, each
able to wait minutes on the global Finviz throttle). Role trade_ai carries
idle_in_transaction_session_timeout=120s, so the server killed the session mid-run (28 FATALs on
2026-11-09), the tier's commit raised 'connection already closed' (620 in logs/market_data.log),
and ingest_quotes swallowed it and handed the entire miss list to yfinance — 45 rows/run on a
failed tier vs 28 on a committed one, on a source the outlook method bans. This gate pins: no
provider call is made while a transaction is open; a lost connection is repaired through
lib/pg_reconnect (bounded) and the run continues; a symbol the tier could not attempt is
unwritten, never missing, and is NOT routed to the next provider; only a genuine finviz
'no quote' reaches yfinance; and the second live writer (a news gap in
process_watchlist_agent_jobs) no longer writes a yfinance quote. Fakes only: no DB, no network.
